whyApp.a: InstantMilega needs your live location for matching, alerts and tracking, which works reliably only in the app. Jobs, skills, experts and events stay on the website as they are. <link>Browse jobs</link>

launch.a: Soon, on Android and iOS. Leave your number on this page and we will tell you the day it is live.

cost.a: Creating a profile, looking around and your first 3 chats are free. Booking or taking work needs the ₹99 pass. KaamMilega takes no commission on the service itself; if a small platform fee applies, you see it before you confirm.

noAccept.a: Each worker gets 120 seconds, then the request moves on. If nobody is free, you can pick another time or offer a higher rate.

cancel.a: Before a worker accepts, you get a full refund. Once they are on the way, a small fee goes to the worker; after they arrive, a visit fee. Cancelled bookings count towards your pass.

parts.a: Parts or extra material are paid to the worker directly. The service itself is paid online in the app.

oneAccount.q: Can I hire and work from the same account?
oneAccount.a: Yes. One KaamMilega account lets you hire, work and find jobs; switch between Hire and Work at the top of the app.

hrCalls.q: How does direct HR calling work on KaamMilega?
hrCalls.a: KaamMilega connects you directly with employers. When you apply, the employer can call, message or WhatsApp you to set up an interview, with no middlemen.

fees.q: Is there any charge or brokerage fee to apply for jobs?
fees.a: No. Applying for jobs on KaamMilega is always free, with no brokerage. You are never asked to pay a registration fee, interview charge or placement commission.

verification.q: How does Aadhaar verification help me?
verification.a: A verified profile shows employers that your identity has been checked, which helps you stand out when they shortlist candidates.

resume.q: Can I apply for jobs without an English resume?
resume.a: Yes. Fill in your details, skills and experience in your KaamMilega profile, and employers see it when you apply.

instant.q: What is InstantMilega™ and how fast can I start working?
instant.a: InstantMilega is quick local work in the KaamMilega app, launching soon. Turn on Free now to get alerts for work near you; each alert gives you 120 seconds to accept.

track.q: How do I track the status of my submitted applications?
track.a: Open My Applications to see where each application stands, from review and shortlisting to interviews and offers.
